summary: geography.json places every Wonderland location on a real, walkable family estate and village in the waking world. The SUP registry (the single record for impossible elements) treats those places as dream-only space.

evidence.geography: LOC-descent-shaft: 'a real, modestly-sized disused cellar shaft with genuine built-in shelving' (geo-xda-02)
evidence.conflicts_with: SUP-008: 'explicitly not a real well or shaft that exists in the film's waking geography'

evidence.geography: LOC-tree-hatch plus spatial_relations: the hall 'never disappeared'; Alice re-enters through a second hatch in a hollow tree (geo-xda-03)
evidence.conflicts_with: SUP-013: the hall's disappearance is dream discontinuity; the hall/door/garden set is 'never re-established' and not part of a mappable waking location

evidence.geography: LOC-ornamental-pool: the pool sits at ground level outside the hedge hatch, 'not inside the underground hall' (geo-xda-04)
evidence.conflicts_with: SUP-007 (the flood fills the hall at Alice's giant scale) and the source itself, ch002-p07: 'a large pool all round her, about four inches deep and reaching half down the hall'. world.json cp-pool grounds the pool in the waking world as the river backwater, not a manor pool.

evidence.geography: LOC-manor-grounds 'The Family's Riverside Grounds': the hole, pool, garden, wood, Rabbit's house (a 'gamekeeper's cottage') and Duchess's house (a 'dower house') are all on the family's own estate
evidence.conflicts_with: world.json frame.social_class (upper-middle-class clergyman-scholar household in a university town; the house is 'a short run' from a meadow at the edge of a field next to a working farm), not a landed estate with lodges

evidence.geography: geo-xda-01: 'this map is designed to hold under either fork of the dream-frame ruling'
evidence.conflicts_with: XA-magic-04: dream-only spaces must not be filed as ordinary persistent LOC-* places; scenes set there use space_class non_diegetic_mental (WRITE_RULES section 4)

options.label: Dream-space (follows the SUP registry)
options.effect: Keep the waking-world places real (bank, field, hedge and burrow, river backwater, farm, family house). Wonderland places stay as LOC-* entries but are re-filed under a dream layer with no real-world parent, estate ownership or plumbing. Drop the cellar shaft, second hatch and ground-level pool; the pool is back in the hall. Scenes there use space_class non_diegetic_mental. Each dream place may keep a 'built_from' pointer to its waking counterpart (world.json wonderland_real_counterparts).

options.label: Layered map (keep geography's estate as what the dream is built from)
options.effect: Keep the physical estate map as the real places the dream reuses. SUP-008 and SUP-013 must be amended, and world.json's family class and setting must grow to a landed estate. The source conflict on the pool (ch002-p07) remains.

options.label: Literal real afternoon
options.effect: Contradicts SUP-001 and world.json as a whole; would reopen every SUP entry. Not recommended.

recommendation: A (matches SUP-001/007/008/013, world.json and the source text). 02-worldbuilding/geography reworks after the ruling.
